title: Palak dal (lentils with spinach) and basmati rice
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer with 700 ml water and turmeric for 20–25 minutes until soft.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the onion, garlic, ginger and tomato, briefly toast the cumin in the oil, add the vegetables and fry for 5 minutes.
Stir the vegetables, spinach and garam masala into the lentils, simmer for 3 minutes and season with salt and lemon juice.
